description: Retrieves a certified chat certificate including its status, message range, and PDF download URL. Prerequisites: the certificate must have been created with chat_certificate_create. Returns documentUrl when status is CERTIFIED. Example: chat_certificate_get({ caseFileId: '...', chatId: '...', id: '...' })

caseFileId.description: UUID of the case file that owns the chat

id.description: UUID of the certificate to retrieve

name: chat_certificate_get
